text_block_list.text:
One day, after Грасс Вандер has a
number of
victories under her belt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I have a moment of your
time?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I was thinking now that the Twinkle
Series has
settled down, it might be a
good time to fulfill
that promise.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list:
You mean... go on that hot spring trip we won at
the raffle?

text_block_list.text:
Yes. If your schedule allows for it, would
you be
willing to accompany me?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I immediately agree to go. Chances to
kick back
and blow off steam like this
don't come up every
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Here we are, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
This natural hot spring is said to relieve
fatigue,
mental strain, muscle soreness,
and stiff
shoulders.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I've found that being knowledgeable
about a
destination makes the trip more
enjoyable.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
In fact, hot springs have been a part of
Japanese
culture since the times of the
Kojiki and Nihon
Shoki.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It was all so interesting, so I read as
much as I
could. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She's as diligent as always, even on
vacation. We
walk into the inn together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... The water was wonderful.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The soothing heat seems to have washed
away
every last trace of my exhaustion
from racing. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: ...Um, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel it would be a waste
for us to
return to our rooms now. Could
we go for a walk?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... This place really does have a
wonderful
view of the stars.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It sure is! ♪ The view from the outdoor
bath was
so magnificent...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It made me want to see it again with
you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The sky is like sand, a stardust of
countless lights,
and somewhere out
there... As though to return
my gaze, a
star seems to shine at me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: A poem written by Shiki Masaoka.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Just like him, as I gaze up at the night
sky, I feel
like there's a star shining for
me too.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I think that star is you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yes.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The steep path I travel has been fraught
with
obstacles. The journey hasn't been
easy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The only reason I was able to make it
through
with no regrets is because you
have been there to
guide me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Watching over me, lighting the way
forward...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: That's because you are my star, Grass.

text_block_list.text:
Just like all the shining stars above us,
there are
countless Umamusume aiming
for the top.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But there was only one light that caught
my eye
and refused to let it go. It came
from the
Umamusume named Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, we're each other's stars? Then we
could
consider our meeting destiny.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Or is that an overblown thing to say?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So long as we are there to light each
other's
paths, neither of us will go
astray.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
My determination will drive me forward,
as
always.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No matter how steep the climb, you and
I will
ascend together, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I sense that Грасс Вандер and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
